H1.hypothesis: H1: Retrieval quality decreases significantly as CMI increases, on the same corpus/model.
H1.test_used: Spearman rank correlation (CMI vs MRR) with Paired Bootstrap 95% CI on rho
H1.details: Spearman rho=0.0908 (95% CI: [-0.0256, 0.2036]), p=0.1082 across 314 queries on BGE-M3.
H1.power_analysis: With n=314, 80% power at alpha=0.05 can detect a minimum correlation of rho=0.1575.

H2.hypothesis: H2: Indic-tuned encoders degrade less than general multilingual encoders under code-mixing, at matched CMI.
H2.test_used: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (Indic-SBERT vs BGE-M3) with Paired Bootstrap 95% CI on effect size
H2.details: Indic-SBERT mean MRR=0.6035 vs BGE-M3 mean MRR=0.8465 (mean diff=-0.2429, 95% CI: [-0.2937, -0.1933]). Rank-biserial r_rb=-0.7182 (95% CI: [-0.8194, -0.6062]).

H3.hypothesis: H3 (optional): Retrieval-stage degradation significantly predicts downstream answer-quality degradation.
H3.details: Optional generation layer deferred per plan §6; no paired downstream answer-quality ratings generated on disk at pilot phase.

H4.hypothesis: H4: SETU-processed queries achieve significantly higher Recall@k/MRR/nDCG than raw queries, with recovery increasing with CMI.
H4.test_used: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (RAW vs SETU v1 MRR) with Paired Bootstrap 95% CI on effect size

H5.hypothesis: H5: SETU's recovery is significantly greater than embedding-interpolation mixing and generic Rewrite-Retrieve-Read, at matched CMI, with comparable or lower overhead.
H5.details: External benchmark arms (interpolation mixing, Rewrite-Retrieve-Read) scheduled for Phase 5 full-scale evaluation.

H6.hypothesis: H6: SETU v2 (learned controller) significantly outperforms SETU v1 (fixed-order, always-4-steps).
H6.test_used: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (SETU v1 vs SETU v2 MRR) with Paired Bootstrap 95% CI on effect size
H6.details: SETU v1 MRR=0.8475 vs SETU v2 MRR=0.8503 (p=0.3792, mean diff=0.0028, 95% CI: [-0.0074, 0.0134]). Quality is statistically equivalent.
H6.power_analysis: With n=314, 80% power at alpha=0.05 can detect a minimum effect size of d=0.1581.

H10.hypothesis: H10: Proxy confidence signals (e.g., score margin) accurately correlate with retrieval success.

H7.hypothesis: H7: LQP alone recovers CMI-driven degradation.
H7.test_used: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (RAW vs LQP MRR)

H8.hypothesis: H8: SETU v2 matches quality with fewer steps than v1.
H8.test_used: Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test (v1 steps vs v2 steps)
H8.details: v1 mean steps = 4.0000 vs v2 mean steps = 1.5955 (p=0.0000). Rank-biserial r_rb=-1.0000 (95% CI: [-1.0000, -1.0000]).

H9.hypothesis: H9: v2 step count correlates positively with CMI.
